kurz: Salt boosts flavour, draws out water, keeps water in meat and tightens dough. The right amount depends on timing.
bild_im_kopf: A dial with a narrow sweet spot: too little is bland, too much is inedible.
was_passiert: A little salt lifts aromas and dampens bitterness. More salt draws out water and seasons through. Too much drowns out everything. Reduced sauces get saltier over time.
faustregeln: A little early, adjust at the end.
Salt pasta water well, sauces only at the end.
